cards.title: vibe card additional features and work

comments.text:
│  Closed out M004-z40dyy (Vibe Cards milestone) then vibed a full polish pass on the feature. Fixed title
│  input clearing on modal open (missing oninput handlers + focus guard in renderVibeModal). Replaced
│  VIBE_LANES with 1-per-phase lanes matching board column names exactly (Discussing→Done), added legacy remap
│  for old lane ids. Removed status field from modal and card renderer. Fixed create/delete not closing the
│  modal (saving/deleting flags were still true when closeVibeModal was called — moved close to finally after
│  clearing flags). Removed Card ID field from modal. Added hide/unhide for milestone cards and quick chips
│  with localStorage persistence and "Show hidden (N)" header toggle. Fixed instance delete X button
│  (e.currentTarget was null for inline onclick — switched to addEventListener). Added native macOS folder
│  picker for Add Instance via /api/pick-folder osascript endpoint. Added Vibe Card comments: POST/DELETE
│  /api/vibe-cards/:id/comments backend, full comments thread in modal below description (append-only,
│  timestamped, hover-delete). Moved "+ Vibe" button to main header. Fixed drag to empty Researching/Planning
│  columns by moving dragover/drop listeners to colEl with min-height. Fixed all field-input width by adding
│  width:100% box-sizing:border-box to .field-input.
